about: The Most Wanted board as data. most-wanted.html renders from this file; most-wanted-tracker.csv is generated from it by tools/build-tracker.mjs. Community entries arrive as submissions (see submission.schema.json and README.md in this folder) and are merged here on acceptance.

formula.note: Component scores are published per entry when the board has assigned them; null means not yet scored in public. Priority is the board's editorial band and is what the page displays.

rules: Bounties for devices to teardown and document.
Bounties for rare public documents - collect and preserve.
Bounties for original documentation written from public research.
No bounties for sealed (NDA) documents - that is a market for stolen trade secrets.
Circumvention material is never listed and never a target.

entries.name: Humane AI Pin
entries.soughtFor: Failed 2024 startup device, now disappearing from the market. Snapdragon-based wearable with almost no public board-level documentation.
entries.whyItMatters: documents an entire product category's rise and fall at the silicon level.

entries.name: Rabbit R1
entries.soughtFor: MediaTek-powered AI handheld. Little verified teardown data exists on its internals, power design, or component choices.
entries.whyItMatters: independent examination of heavily marketed AI hardware.

entries.name: Apple Vision Pro
entries.soughtFor: Dual-chip (M2 + R1) spatial computer. Apple publishes nothing about the board; independent analysis is scarce and the display stack is unique.
entries.whyItMatters: the most complex consumer board of its generation, undocumented.

entries.name: Nintendo Switch 2
entries.soughtFor: New generation hardware with unknown silicon revisions, board layout, and repairability characteristics.
entries.whyItMatters: baseline documentation before revisions and cost-downs change the design.

entries.name: Meta Quest Pro
entries.soughtFor: Discontinued headset with pancake-lens optics and Snapdragon XR2+ board. Units are vanishing; the display assembly deserves recording.
entries.whyItMatters: preservation of a short-lived premium design.

entries.name: DJI Avata 2
entries.soughtFor: FPV drone with OcuSync video pipeline and tight firmware lockdown.
entries.whyItMatters: independent examination of video transmission hardware the manufacturer keeps closed.

entries.name: Amazon Astro
entries.soughtFor: Home robot, rare in the wild, with an unknown sensor and compute stack.
entries.whyItMatters: almost no public hardware analysis of a shipping home robot.

entries.name: Oura Ring 4
entries.soughtFor: Extremely compact wearable; no public teardown of the current generation.
entries.whyItMatters: miniaturization techniques worth studying and recording.

entries.name: Peloton Bike+
entries.whyItMatters: documents the connected-hardware category where software decisions can limit hardware you own.

entries.name: Steam Deck OLED
entries.soughtFor: Valve handheld with some existing coverage.
entries.whyItMatters: the HDR OLED panel supply chain and revised board layout deserve a complete record.
